policy.name: SYNTHETIC — fictional Summary of Benefits and Coverage

clauses.text: What must I pay before benefits? The individual deductible is $1,000.00 in network and $2,000.00 out of network.
clauses.location: What must I pay before benefits?

clauses.text: What is my annual limit? Covered sharing stops at $5,000.00 in network and $10,000.00 out of network.
Can providers collect excess charges? Participating providers cannot. Nonparticipating providers may.

Calculation and accumulation rules: For covered care apply any remaining deductible first, then the stated copay, then member coinsurance to the remaining allowed amount. Round coinsurance half up to cents. Apply the remaining annual OOP cap to deductible, copay and coinsurance in that order. Only actually assessed covered sharing accrues. In- and out-of-network annual pools are separate. Permitted excess equals charge minus allowance and is outside OOP. Excluded care is full-charge patient liability outside deductible and OOP, with no insurer payment. No excess billing is allowed in network. A waived deductible means no deductible applies to that benefit.
B1: CT scan (CPT/HCPCS 74177), in-network: covered; deductible applies; member copay $0.00; member coinsurance 20%.
B2: Ultrasound (CPT/HCPCS 76700), in-network: covered; deductible applies; member copay $0.00; member coinsurance 20%.

warnings: Synthetic data notice: This document is a fictional SBC for testing purposes.
Rounding convention: Coinsurance is rounded half-up to cents as an engine convention; the policy does not explicitly state rounding for coinsurance.
The policy states 'One visit/unit per line unless explicitly documented as a duplicate.' This may affect multiple units of the same service; the engine assumes one unit per claim line.
coverage_gaps: No out-of-network benefits are listed; only in-network CT scan and ultrasound are compiled.
No balance billing information for out-of-network providers beyond the general statement that nonparticipating providers may collect excess charges; this is captured as balance_billing true.
No other services (e.g., office visits, urgent care, ER, drugs) are listed in the benefits section.
The policy does not specify whether the deductible applies to out-of-network benefits; only in-network benefits are listed.
The policy does not specify whether the OOP maximum includes out-of-network cost sharing; the out-of-network OOP maximum is listed but no out-of-network benefits are compiled.
